Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Robotics is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for the fleet platform team in Berlin (hybrid).

What you will do
- Own the telemetry ingestion service that receives events from thousands of robots
- Design APIs used by the fleet console and by customers
- Mentor junior engineers and lead technical design reviews
- Take part in the on-call rotation

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional experience with Node.js and TypeScript
- Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, including query optimisation
- Experience designing and operating event-driven systems (Kafka or similar)
- Experience mentoring engineers
- Clear written and spoken English

Nice to have
- Familiarity with Kubernetes
- Bonus points for experience in robotics or logistics
- Exposure to Go

Data Scientist, Demand Forecasting

Northwind Analytics (Copenhagen, remote-friendly)

You will build and ship forecasting models for grocery and fashion retailers.

Must have
- 3+ years applying machine learning to time-series data
- Python (pandas, scikit-learn) and SQL
- Experience deploying models to production on GCP or AWS
- Ability to explain results to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred
- Experience with retail or supply-chain data
- Familiarity with dbt

React developer needed.
Remote, start immediately.
